name: Archery Target
summary:
Archery’s Target is a fast-paced VR archery game built for Meta Quest.

Test your precision, reflexes, and focus across multiple competitive game modes including Time Mode, Hit Mode, and Infinite Mode. 

Compete for high scores, challenge yourself with increasingly difficult targets, and experience immersive bow and arrow gameplay in realistic outdoor environments designed specifically for virtual reality players and VR sports fans.
